name: Politics & ideas
grading_rules: Grade the claim as stated. Documented = institutional facts, dates, laws, votes and what thinkers/parties actually argued, as the evidence states them. Debated = contested interpretations, causes, effects of policies, or anything scholars or parties dispute: say who disputes it. Legend = popular political myths or misquotes the evidence contradicts. Interpretation = narrator's framing. Unsupported = no card says it. Never grade a value judgement (good/bad policy) as Documented.
